### Skills

### Education
BSc Lorem Ipsum, Example University, 2018

Hiring Team, Acme Robotics

**Re: Senior Lorem Engineer**

Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm writing to apply for the Senior Lorem Engineer role at Acme Robotics. I have spent the last several years building and running backend services, first as an Ipsum Developer at Sample Studio and, since 2021, as a Senior Lorem Engineer at Example Co. The way your posting describes the Fleet Platform team, small, trusted with real systems and close to the people who use them, is the kind of team I do my best work in.

At Example Co I own services that other teams build on every day. I've learned that the work that matters most is often the least visible: clear interfaces, careful releases, and documentation that answers the next person's question before they ask it. I care about the people on call as much as the code, and I try to leave every system a little easier to run than I found it.

Before that, at Sample Studio, I worked across the stack on client projects with short deadlines. It taught me to ask good questions early, to agree on what "done" means, and to ship in small steps that are easy to check and easy to undo.

What draws me to Acme Robotics is the chance to work on software that has to be dependable, because it moves real work in the physical world. I'd bring steady habits to that: reviewing carefully, measuring before optimising, and mentoring the engineers around me so the whole team moves faster.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I could help the Fleet Platform team, and I'm happy to share examples of my work.

Kind regards,
John Doe
